**[P1] Contain `BaseException` before publishing progress**

If `flush()` consistently raises a `BaseException` such as `CancelledError`, each replacement worker fails and `drain()` respawns another forever, hanging the invocation. During `export()`, this `finally` also marks the record complete even when the first exporter aborts the loop, so later exporters permanently miss it. Isolate these failures per exporter or disable the failing exporter before advancing coverage; add tests for an always-failing flush and a failing exporter followed by a healthy one.
